headline: Dhir & Dhir Associates assists in Powertronix Engineering proposed IPO
sum: Powertronix Engineering Limited has proposed an initial public offering of up to 41,00,000 Equity Shares on the SME Platform of BSE. Dhir & Dhir Associates is advising the Lead Manager, Khandwala Securities Limited on this IPO.
detail: Powertronix Engineering Limited has proposed an initial public offering of up to 41,00,000 Equity Shares on the SME Platform of BSE. Dhir & Dhir Associates is advising the Lead Manager, Khandwala Securities Limited on this IPO. The Firm played an instrumental role in drafting and filing the Draft Prospectus with the stock exchange, enabling seamless transaction execution. The transaction was led by Guranpreet Singh Sarna (Partner), with support from Harshita Asopa (Senior Associate) and Shubhangi Gupta (Associate).
